title: Kiritani Haruka — The Future We're Wishing For〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Shrine Hall

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Now that we've learned the proper etiquette for being shrine maidens, let's give it our best shot!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's make sure everyone who visits is able to fondly look back upon this past year and look forward to the next one!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Oh, but there's something I need to ask you all to do...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We've lightly disguised ourselves just in case this time...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But in the event that some of our fans do realize who we are, please tell them that, “We're volunteering here on our own time.”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Good idea. We may also want to ask them to refrain from taking pictures and posting them online.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay!
We wouldn't want to cause the shrine or its visitors any trouble so...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. I'm sure they'll understand as long as we ask them politely.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Still, Haruka, your fans are gonna be so surprised when they see you here... Dressed as a shrine maiden no less...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Some might even think that this is a shrine dedicated to you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A shrine dedicated to Haruka...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Well, I mean...
Kiritani Shrine

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright, we're here!
I'm gonna make so many wishes this year!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hm? Wait, is that...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
H-Haruka?!
What are you doing here?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This is the Kiritani Shrine, so it's only natural for me to be here.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh-What?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-Is this my reward for working so hard this past year...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Why don't I make a wish with you?
Oh, I could ask for you to have another great year.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Okay!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Something like that...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That didn't make any sense at all!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You have such a vivid imagination, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, doesn't a shrine dedicated to Haruka means that there'd also be a festival to celebrate her?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
A Haruka festival?!
That'd be amazing!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wouldn't it also be fun to dance and parade around while carrying a little shrine in her honor?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, it absolutely would be!
Oh, what if we had lanterns that look like penguins!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we could even wave around blue glow sticks and offer delicious sweets in celebration.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We'll need lots of merch too, like charms and ceremonial arrows in Haruka's image...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Merch...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You've gone from being a shrine maiden to a goddess...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Do you have any words to offer your overzealous followers, your divineness?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm the furthest thing from divine, but alright... Ahem...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Minori, Shizuku...
Hear my words.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Eep!
Th-That voice...!!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's the great Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
This is hallowed ground...
You must behave accordingly as the shrine maidens you are.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you!
We will!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We promise not to disappoint!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hah!
Seriously? None of you came up with a punchline for that?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Haha. Sorry about that, you two. Our divine comedy tragically must come to an end.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe... That actually helped me a lot, Haruka! I feel like I can make it through today now!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I feel the same way!
If anything, I'm more inclined to do my part as a shrine maiden now!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's good to hear.
But I feel a little embarrassed about my performance just now... I hope no one up there was watching...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But it worked, didn't it?
That's Haruka Kiritani for you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Anyway, we should head over soon.
Shall we?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(A shrine dedicated to me...
I really don't deserve anything like that...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I just want to make it so all these hopeful visitors get to make their wishes today.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, let's give it everything we have today! Ready?

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!
